def bisect_left(xs, v):
    """Return the leftmost index at which v can be inserted into the
    sorted list xs so that xs remains sorted.

    If v is already present in xs, the returned index points at the
    first (leftmost) occurrence of v.

    An empty list returns 0.
    """
    lo, hi = 0, len(xs)
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if xs[mid] < v:
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            hi = mid
    return lo
